description: This file defines the TeleSuiteUpdater class responsible for managing test suite updates, reporting, and error handling within a testing framework, including methods for processing reports and configuring reporters.

classes.name: TeleSuiteUpdater
classes.description: Manages test suite updates, report processing, and error handling, providing methods to create reporters, process reports, and generate a model of current test state.

methods.name: _createReporter
methods.description: Creates a ReporterV2 object with event handlers for configuration, test start/end, errors, and other report events.

methods.name: processGlobalReport
methods.description: Processes a global report array, dispatching messages to a new TeleReporterReceiver.

methods.name: processListReport
methods.description: Processes a list report, saving current test results, resetting the receiver, and dispatching messages.

methods.name: processTestReportEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a test report event message to the appropriate receivers, maintaining order.

methods.name: _handleOnError
methods.description: Handles errors by recording them, invoking error callbacks, and updating the report.

methods.name: asModel
methods.description: Returns the current state of the test suite, configuration, errors, and progress as a model object.
